== Usage ==
A small labelled callout marking a verified fact, visually distinct from
EDFM's own editorial judgement -- pairs with {{tl|Field manual
recommendation}}. Added 2026-08-08 as part of formalising the Fact/
Field Manual Recommendation distinction across Engineer articles — see
[[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Engineering Architecture]] for why EDFM
treats things like blueprint-pinning guidance as editorial judgement, not
a database fact.

<pre>
{{Fact|1=The Dweller's confirmed specialty is Power Distributor.}}
</pre>

Keep the content to one short, genuinely-verified statement. If it needs
a source citation or a longer explanation, put the citation/explanation in
the article body and use this template only for the short summary line.
Never use this template for a claim that hasn't actually been verified —
that's what the inline uncertainty flags (e.g. ''Unverified'',
''Community-reported'') and [[Template:Article status]] are for.

[[Category:Templates]]
</noinclude>
